dialogues.speaker: Jazari
dialogues.text: Urgh, we're running out of money, but there haven't been any breakthroughs in my research...

dialogues.speaker: Jazari
dialogues.text: I won't be able to afford meals if this goes on.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Amurta's project...

dialogues.speaker: Jazari
dialogues.text: I've applied for it, but haven't heard anything since then... Could the academic trends have changed recently?

dialogues.speaker: Jazari
dialogues.text: As the saying goes, "The road to happiness is fraught with setbacks." Sometimes one has to wait a bit longer for a positive outcome.

dialogues.speaker: Jazari
dialogues.text: Don't worry, when that day comes, I won't forget your contribution.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Jazari
dialogues.text: Organizing the research results from before, of course.

dialogues.speaker: Jazari
dialogues.text: I didn't expect such a giant volume of data. I don't know how much more time this will cost me.

dialogues.speaker: Jazari
dialogues.text: But it would be irresponsible to publish the results before organizing them.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sorry to bother you.

dialogues.speaker: Jazari
dialogues.text: *sigh* Come look for me when the funding has been secured.

dialogues.speaker: Jazari
dialogues.text: Haha, I will definitely become the greatest researcher of my era if I finish organizing the manuscript of Pir Kavikavus.

dialogues.speaker: Jazari
dialogues.text: Not only will I be promoted to Herbad, I could even be addressed as Pir Jazari.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So "Pir" is a title?

dialogues.speaker: Jazari
dialogues.text: Isn't it? I'm not too sure either. Only the Hara{RUBY#[S]Semiotics}vatat fellows care about these things.

dialogues.speaker: Jazari
dialogues.text: We Kshahrewar are only concerned about genuine techniques.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Sumeru cuisine...

dialogues.speaker: Jazari
dialogues.text: Huh? I don't remember promising to treat you guys to any Sumeru cuisine.

dialogues.speaker: Jazari
dialogues.text: But since you've helped me out loads, I don't mind treating you to a meal of Curry Shrimp or something similar.

dialogues.speaker: Jazari
dialogues.text: But let's wait until my results have been published successfully. I'll make sure to fill your bellies, be it Curry Shrimp, or even Tandoori Roast Chicken!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I wish you success.

dialogues.speaker: Jazari
dialogues.text: Haha, that's for sure. Just wait to read my thank-you note.
